correctness.rationale: Exact stationary Lyapunov equation gives unique covariance for positive local returns. Independent symbolic code reconstructs the three-patch rational V and its eighth-degree derivative P. Descartes signs ++++----+ give at most two positive zeros; P(0)>0, P(1/10)<0, P(3)>0 give at least two, so exactly two strict extrema. Generic two-patch differentiation is symbolic-checked and coefficient sign thresholds are strictly ordered for a<b, allowing at most one positive zero. Equal-rate two-patch aggregate and one-patch cases are constant. Strict signs persist in an open parameter neighborhood. Scope excludes global optimality, non-Gaussian nonlinear trajectories and extinction risk.

value.rationale: The smallest habitat-network size permitting reentrant stabilizing/destabilizing/stabilizing regional variability is a motivated structural boundary, not an arbitrary numerical optimization slice. The model has heterogeneous return rates and environmental noise; corridor policies can show multiple reversals even with constant forcings. Exact integer model parameters, rational analytic root certificate and open robustness establish a genuine persistent phenomenon. Does not claim field data or general downstream theorem.
